marketing_description: The DV2000WG sanitizing gas dryer offers a 7.4 cu‑ft capacity and 22500 BTU gas heating, with a 710‑rpm galvanized steel drum. It includes a sanitize cycle, moisture sensor, 11 cycles, and 5 temperature settings, all housed in a white finish with compact dimensions of 42‑3/4 in H × 26‑7/8 in W × 28 in D (depth with door open 51‑1/2 in, height with lid open 38‑1/4 in). This model is powered by natural gas and designed for efficient commercial use.
